Increase Innervating Locket's Health and Mana restored by @RestoreMultiplier*100@%.

Innervating Locket restores Health and Mana to all allied champions around your target.

If you thought that Udyr was unkillable before...

fields.name: Upgrade Mikael's Blessing
fields.tooltip:
Gain Mikael's Blessing. Reduce Mikael's Blessing Cooldown to @Cooldown@ seconds.

On Mikael's Blessing activate, unleashes a wave to nearby ally champions, cleansing Disabling and Immobilizing effects, restoring @HealCalc@ Health, and granting @TenacityAmount*100@% Tenacity for @TenacityDuration@ seconds.

fields.tooltip: {{Kiwi_Upgrade_SwordOfBlossom_Summary}}

fields.tooltip: After @ThornshieldCooldown@ seconds out of combat, your Thornmail or Bramble Vest generates a shell that reflects @ThornShieldDamage@ damage from Attacks.

fields.name: Upgrade: Zz'Rot Portal
fields.tooltip:
Zz'Rot Portal spawns @BaseMinionAdd@ additional minion, plus an additional minion for every @LevelsPerMinion@ levels you have.

Minions are also spawned when the portal is destroyed.

fields.name: Virtuous Cycle
fields.tooltip:
Your heals grant an extra @ShieldFromHealPercentage*100@% Shield and your Shields grant an extra @HealFromShieldPercentage*100@% Healing.

Total Healing Done: @f1@
Shields Generated: @f2@

fields.name: Void Dash
fields.tooltip:
{{SpellName}} spawns a Void Zone at the targeted destination. It Slows enemy champions for @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds, and deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Champions Slowed: @f1@

fields.name: Wind Beneath Blade
fields.tooltip:
Gain @MSFromBasePen@ Movement Speed from flat %i:scaleAPen%Armor Penetration and %i:scaleMPen%Magic Penetration. Gain @PercentPenConversion@ Movement Speed every @PercentPenConversion@% of your percent %i:scaleAPen%Armor Penetration and %i:scaleMPen%Magic Penetration

Gain @f2@ Movement Speed.

fields.name: Spin Me Right Round
fields.tooltip:
Replace a Summoner Spell with Heroic Swing.

Heroic Swing fires a grappling hook, sticking into terrain, after which you can Recast to swing around it. While swinging, automatically Attack the nearest enemy. Colliding with an enemy champion or Recasting ends the swing.
